name: @pipeworx/mcp-stackexchange

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search for questions on StackOverflow or any StackExchange site. Returns title, body, score, answer count, tags, and link.

site.description: StackExchange site slug (default: stackoverflow). Examples: serverfault, superuser, askubuntu, math, physics

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default 5)

_apiKey.description: Optional — a StackExchange API key (free, 10k/day) for a dedicated quota. The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

tools.name: get_answers
tools.description: Get answers for a specific StackExchange question by ID. Returns answer body, score, and whether it is accepted.

question_id.description: The numeric question ID from the question URL

_apiKey.description: Optional — a StackExchange API key (free, 10k/day) for a dedicated quota. The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

tools.name: stack_get_user
tools.description: Look up a StackExchange user by numeric ID. Returns display name, reputation, badges (gold/silver/bronze counts), location, website, account age, last access, and per-site activity counts (questions/answers). Works on any StackExchange site (default: stackoverflow).

user_id.description: The numeric StackExchange user ID (visible in profile URL, e.g., stackoverflow.com/users/17034 → 17034)

site.description: StackExchange site slug (default: stackoverflow). Examples: serverfault, superuser, askubuntu, math, physics

_apiKey.description: Optional — a StackExchange API key (free, 10k/day) for a dedicated quota. The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

tools.name: list_questions_by_tag
tools.description: Browse questions by TAG, sorted by votes or recency — answers "top questions tagged <tag>", "trending <tag> questions this week/month", "most-voted <tag> questions". Returns title, score, answer count, whether answered, view count, tags, and link (call get_answers with a returned question_id to read answers). Combine tags with ";" for AND (e.g. "kubernetes;helm"). Distinct from search_questions, which is keyword-based.

tag.description: Tag to browse (e.g. "rust", "kubernetes"). Combine with ";" for AND ("react;typescript").

sort.description: Sort order: votes (default, all-time top), month or week (trending recently), activity (recently active), creation (newest), hot.

site.description: StackExchange site slug (default: stackoverflow). Examples: serverfault, superuser, askubuntu, math, physics

limit.description: Number of questions to return (1-20, default 10)

_apiKey.description: Optional — a StackExchange API key (free, 10k/day) for a dedicated quota. The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

tools.name: stack_tags
tools.description: List or search StackOverflow / StackExchange tags with question counts and synonym info — top tags by popularity, tags matching a name fragment, or stats for specific tags. Answers "most popular StackOverflow tags", "how many questions are tagged X", "which tags have more than N questions". Example: stack_tags({ sort: "popular", limit: 20 }) or stack_tags({ inname: "python" })

inname.description: Filter to tags whose name contains this fragment, e.g. "python"

tags.description: Exact tag names to look up, semicolon-separated, e.g. "java;python;rust"

min_count.description: Only return tags with at least this many questions (server-side when sort=popular)

_apiKey.description: Optional — a StackExchange API key (free, 10k/day) for a dedicated quota. The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-stackexchange forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the stackexchange pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
